section_path: I. THE CIRCUMSTANCES OF THE CASE

text: A summary of the relevant domestic provisions and international documents and reports applicable to this case can be found in the judgment in the case of Galstyan v. Armenia (no. 26986/03, §§ 25-32, 15 November 2007).
